items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So I had some brushes and a newspaper. So just me and him was playing.

ctx.x: No. I remember we were playing a concert in -- when was it? Doing a concert, I think it was in Boston. At the Auditorium in Boston. So we were -- we had about an hour before -- we always got to the place an hour or so, the band would be relaxed. So me and him, he was sitting backstage playing one of the things he used to play with Hot Five, a fast thing, you know. So I had some brushes and a newspaper. So just me and him was playing. He said, "I like that." Duke come in and say, "I like that." So as a surprise…
